# Wildbrook Bevvy Burros

> Wildbrook Bevvy Burros is a mobile beverage service from the Snoqualmie Valley in North Bend, WA. Four bonded mini donkeys and TIPS-certified handlers bring a memorable bar experience to weddings, corporate events, and private parties — "the herd that pours."

Wildbrook Bevvy Burros provides a mobile beverage service built around four bonded miniature donkeys who carry drinks to your guests, paired with TIPS-certified handlers. Based in the Snoqualmie Valley (North Bend, Washington), they serve weddings, corporate events, and private celebrations.

## Atlas — https://wildbrookbevvyburros.com/atlas.html
================================================================

Skip to main content

Mini Donkey · Bonded with Cypress

# Atlas.

"The mischief. The icebreaker at cocktail hour — guests laughing within ninety seconds of arriving."

Atlas is curious. Atlas is opinionated. Atlas will, given the chance, investigate your bar cart. We don't recommend leaving him unsupervised near the cake — he has opinions about cake, and we have learned this the hard way.

He is, however, the single best icebreaker we have ever worked with. Guests who walk in stiff leave the cocktail hour holding a phone full of donkey photos and a softer mood. There is a science to it — there is a softening that happens when a small donkey in a knit bowtie noses your knee — and Atlas is the science.

He works best at festivals, brand activations, and any event where you want guests laughing within ninety seconds of arriving. He travels with his bonded partner Cypress; the two are inseparable from sunrise to sundown and a quiet wonder to watch when no one's looking.

### Stats

Height 34"

Age 4 years

Bonded with Cypress

Best at cocktail hour

Snack apple slices

Style knit bowtie

## Hazel — https://wildbrookbevvyburros.com/hazel.html
================================================================

Skip to main content

Mini Donkey · Bonded with Juniper

# Hazel.

"The aisle pro. Patient through processions, calm with kids, uncannily aware of camera angles."

Hazel is the diplomat of the Wildbrook crew. She is the one you want at your ceremony — patient through processions, calm with kids, and uncannily aware of camera angles. Where the rest of the herd brings noise, Hazel brings presence.

She arrived at Wildbrook in 2023 as a rescue from a hobby farm in Roslyn. Her bonded best friend Juniper travels everywhere she does. Mini donkeys form deep, lifelong pairs from a young age, and we never split a bond — when Hazel is on the schedule, Juniper is too.

She has worked over forty weddings and has not, not even once, sneezed on the bride. She wears eucalyptus garland like she was born to. She likes the soft brass bell on her halter. She is, by quiet consensus around the farm, the most professional employee on staff.

### Stats

Height 32"

Age 7 years

Bonded with Juniper

Best at aisle walks

Snack carrot tops

Style eucalyptus garland

## Rufus — https://wildbrookbevvyburros.com/rufus.html
================================================================

Skip to main content

Mini Donkey · Bonded with Tonka

# Rufus.

"The marquee. The tallest of the four, the calmest in a crowd, and the donkey every photographer asks for by name."

Rufus is the tallest donkey on the Wildbrook roster and the calmest one in a crowd. He moves at the pace of a careful conversation, holds his head with the dignity of someone who has had his portrait painted before, and lets children pet his ears without flinching.

He travels with his bonded partner Tonka — the two of them came to us together from a working ranch outside Cle Elum and have not spent a night apart since. Tonka is the slightly louder of the pair. Rufus is the diplomat.

He wears a custom oak side-pack designed for tall cans and stemmed flutes. He poses for cameras like he was raised by a magazine art director. Reserve Rufus early — he is the donkey most often requested by photographers, and we cap his schedule at twelve events per month so the work stays good for him.

### Stats

Height 36"

Age 6 years

Bonded with Tonka

Best at cocktail hour, reels

Snack timothy hay

Style oak side-pack, tartan ribbon

## Sol — https://wildbrookbevvyburros.com/sol.html
================================================================

Skip to main content

Mini Donkey · Bonded with Marigold

# Sol.

"The sunshine. The brightest disposition on the roster — made for brunch hour, garden parties, and weddings with a daylight first look."

Sol is the optimist of the herd. He greets each new venue like an old friend, leans into a stranger's hand within thirty seconds, and seems to wake up every morning genuinely pleased about the day. We have not yet found a guest who did not smile back at him.

He is bonded with Marigold, a slightly older jenny who arrived at Wildbrook with him in 2024. Marigold sets the pace. Sol does the social work. They are, together, the most easygoing pair we travel with.

His best work is in daylight — brunch socials, ceremony hour, garden parties under string lights. He wears a woven flower crown that our local florist makes fresh on the morning of each event. He has never once tried to eat it. He has, occasionally, tried to eat the bouquet.

### Stats

Height 33"

Age 5 years

Bonded with Marigold

Best at brunch, daytime ceremonies

Snack orchard pears

Style woven flower crown

02 — Included

## In every package, without asking.

Every Wildbrook event ships with the same baseline. Add-ons stay simple — extra hour, extra mileage, signature monogram.

01

### TIPS-certified handler

A trained, alcohol-service-certified handler pairs each donkey, leads the route through your event, and answers your guests' questions without breaking the choreography.

02

### Custom basket dressing

Florals, ribbon, monograms, and brass details coordinated with your designer in the week before your event. We arrive styled — no on-site fuss.

03

### 30-min styling window

Quiet on-site setup before guests arrive. Photographer-friendly portraits before service if you want them, no extra charge.

04

### Leave-no-trace breakdown

Collection bags, quiet exit, no mess for your venue or your team. Every event gets the same back-end care, whether it is twenty guests or two hundred.

03 — Add-ons

Simple add-ons, simple pricing. Bundled into your final quote after the discovery call.

- Travel beyond 30 miles $2.40 / mile

- Photographer's first look Included

## About — https://wildbrookbevvyburros.com/about.html

Skip to main content

Our story

# Four donkeys. One small farm.

Wildbrook Bevvy Burros is a two-handler operation on a working farm at the foot of Mt. Si — a slow, careful version of the beverage-burro idea, built around four bonded mini donkeys and the events that suit them.

01 — The beginning

## A herd built on bonds.

Wildbrook started in 2022 with a pair of rescued mini donkeys — Hazel and Juniper — pastured on a five-acre property outside North Bend. We did not, at first, plan to start a business. We planned to give two donkeys a quiet retirement and learn how to be patient.

The donkeys had other ideas. Hazel turned out to be the most composed animal anyone in our circle had ever met. Friends started asking if she could come to weddings. Then garden parties. Then a brand activation at a brewery in Issaquah. By the spring of 2024 we had two more bonded pairs on the farm — Rufus and Tonka, Sol and Marigold — and a phone that would not stop ringing.

Today Wildbrook is four working mini donkeys, two TIPS-certified handlers, and a small fleet of custom oak side-packs. We are deliberately small. We do not plan to scale. The donkeys come first, the work is paced around them, and the events we say yes to are the ones we know we can do well.

02 — The standard

## Why the Wildbrook way.

A small team that obsesses over the details so your guests can stay in the moment, and so the donkeys go home tired in the good way.

01

### TIPS-certified handlers

Every Wildbrook handler is alcohol-service certified in Washington and has logged a minimum of forty supervised events before they lead one. We are trained for weddings, festivals, and crowds — and we read the room before we read the order.

02

### Leave-no-trace

Our donkeys wear discreet collection bags. We arrive on a quiet schedule, set up out of the photographer's line, and leave every venue cleaner than we found it. Our partner venues do not have to ask twice.

03

### Custom dressing

Florals from your designer, ribbon from your color story, monograms, garlands, brass bells. The herd arrives styled for your day, not ours, and we coordinate with your planner and florist a week in advance.

04

### PNW born and raised

Every donkey on the roster was rescued or sourced within a thirty-mile radius of Mt. Si. We know our valleys, our venues, and the back roads in. We do not deliver donkeys we do not know.

0 Mini donkeys on staff

0 Certified handlers

0 Mile service radius

0 Hour reply window

03 — How we work

## Slow, careful, on the donkey's clock.

Mini donkeys are bonded animals. They live in pairs from a young age and they do not travel alone — when one donkey comes to your event, their partner comes too. This is not a marketing choice. It is how donkeys work, and it is the reason ours stay calm in unfamiliar places.

We cap each donkey's schedule at twelve events per month. We do not book back-to-back weekends in peak season. We do not work in temperatures over 88°F or under 32°F. Our handlers pair the right donkey to your event based on your venue, your guest count, and the time of day — you do not pick a donkey by name, because we know which pair will hold up best, and that is the work we are paid for.
